text:
lexi: hey team! just landed — quick q about network access and the onboarding bot noise. my laptop can't reach the internal wiki (https://intra.redwood). tried opening the onboarding checklist but it times out. any quick steps?
mika (people-ops): welcome, lexi :tada: Can you confirm you're on the office network or VPN? If you're remote ping which region you're in.
lexi: remote, SF. i'm on home wifi. VPN client installed but not connected (i think). the client shows 'auth failed' when i try to connect.
sam (it): @lexi - ok, start by restarting the VPN client. if that fails, run this from terminal and paste output: `/usr/local/bin/openvpn --config ~/redwood.ovpn` or on windows use the Tunnel GUI and check the logs. also confirm you used the SSO invite link I sent earlier.
lexi: restarting didn't help, here's the small log snippet: "TLS Error: TLS key negotiation failed to occur within 60 seconds"
devon (eng): usually that means your account isn't allowed or the cert didn't provision. @sam can do a remote cert refresh. @lexi, can you DM me your last 4 of employee ID so I can check the firewall rules quickly?
onboard-bot: Reminder: new-hires checklist — Step 3 (Access) is overdue for lexi. Link: https://intra.redwood/checklists/lexi
mika (people-ops): for bot noise: if the checklist reminders are too frequent you can snooze from the message menu -> "More actions" -> "Snooze notifications for 1h" or use `/remind me` commands. we default to a light cadence but you can tailor it.
lexi: thanks — quick question re: where to ask infra vs. eng questions? don't want to spam eng.
devon (eng): good call. infra/network issues -> #eng-infra or DM @sam. product/feature onboarding -> #product or your immediate team channel. for anything onboarding people-ops related ping #new-hires or @mika. short rule: if it's access/setup -> eng-infra / it. if it's role/process -> new-hires / people-ops.
lexi: got it, will ping #eng-infra for VPN. last tiny thing: how to stop the onboarding-bot from DMing me the health surveys?
mika (people-ops): open the DM with @onboard-bot -> click the bot name -> Notifications -> toggle off "Direct messages". if you want periodic surveys only weekly, message `help frequency weekly` to @onboard-bot.
lexi: awesome, that helped. pinging @sam in #eng-infra now. thanks everyone :heart:
sam (it): on it, @lexi. sending a cert refresh and will post when done. expect 5–10 mins. if still failing paste the full log.
devon (eng): also FYI - calendar: onboarding kickoff is at 3pm PT in #general for intros. drop any blockers here and we'll make sure to cover them.
lexi: cool, i'll be there. thanks again!
